{{Quote|She has me hanging up in the main chamber while she digests me. I suppose that's something; a thing to be greatful for in the grand scheme of things. Mica and I came down together when our speeder got shot down, and Mica got hustled back into one of those little openings along the edge, down into the Sarlacc's guts. This is a bad way to die, but that'd be worse, that'd be a ''lot'' worse.|[[Kess]]|<ref name="A Barve Like That: The Tale of Boba Fett">{{StoryCite|story=A Barve Like That: The Tale of Boba Fett|book=Tales from Jabba's Palace}}</ref>}}
A companion to the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] gambler [[Kess]], '''Mica''' was swallowed alive by the [[Sarlacc/Legends|Sarlacc]] in the [[Great Pit of Carkoon/Legends|Great Pit of Carkoon]], doomed to being digested for a thousand years inside the beast.
